rows.grounds: locative adverb referring to the prepared vessel described in the preceding verses
compound sa+aṅga indicating inclusion of ancillary parts
object of worship; name of the Aghora weapon/mantra
compound sa+āsana indicating inclusion of the seat
adverb qualifying the manner of worship

items.question: What manner of worship is required for the Aghora weapon together with its seat and limbs in that prepared vessel?
premises: A prepared vessel has been specified in the preceding context.
The Aghora weapon is to be worshipped together with its limbs and seat.
The act of worship must be performed properly.
items.inference: Therefore, in that prepared vessel one should properly worship the Aghora weapon along with its seat and limbs.
uncertainties: Whether maghorāstraṃ refers specifically to a mantra or to a weapon-form is not fully explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: There, one should properly worship the Aghora weapon together with its seat and its limbs.
